reference.source: REQUIRED: book, plate, figure - or the vocabulary source for an authored exercise
reference.image: OPTIONAL: repo-relative path to the reference/overlay image
reference.source_frame: describe the pixel frame and the anchor station
reference.notes: crop placement may start ESTIMATED; refine against the first front render

datum: REQUIRED: names a parameter below; normalized stations = at / datum

construction_plane.profile_x: +X = describe what this axis means physically
construction_plane.profile_y: +Z = up; the profile frame is ALWAYS y-up as the front camera sees it

every_station.evidence: PRINTED | MEASURED | FITTED | DERIVED | ESTIMATED | AUTHORED
every_station.join: HARD preserves the corner; SMOOTH is a tangent-continuity CLAIM the compiler verifies
every_station.note: source_px is optional; when present it must register against the declared scale

segments.name: unique_name
segments.direction: ARC only: CLOCKWISE | COUNTERCLOCKWISE, in the y-up frame as the front camera sees it. Radius is DERIVED from the centre - never authored.
segments.role: MOULDED (the carved edge production consumes) | BOUNDING (saw planes and stock closure)

solid_side: LEFT | RIGHT of travel; the compiler rejects it if the winding disagrees

claim.kind: free | radius_of | length_of | angle_of | distance | extent

some_dimension.note: claims are verified against the built geometry - printed dims become falsifiable

notes: RULES: segments form ONE closed loop chained by station names (a section is a closed outline, not an open chain).
The moulded face stays distinguishable via role; the stock's bounding planes close the loop.
Author station coordinates FROM measured pixels where they exist; record every inconsistency you resolve as a note.
This template is instructional and deliberately does not compile - copy it, replace every field, delete these instructions.
